to: you: only the socket that sent `render`

example.code: for(var id in data.window) window[id]=data.window[id]; eval(data.after);

variants.name: JSON
variants.when: The admin code set `json_output` and not `window`.

variants.name: Modal
variants.when: The admin code set neither, or it threw: `output` is `"Exception: <error>"`.

SimpleEvalWindow.summary: `simple_eval`: copy values to the `window` of the client.

fields.name: window
fields.description: Values that the admin code put in its local `window`. The client copies them to its `window`.

fields.name: after
fields.description: Code to run after the copy. `""` unless the admin code set it.

fields.name: code
fields.description: The fixed code that copies `window` and runs `after`.

fields.name: output
fields.description: Text that the admin code set, or `"Exception: <error>"` when it threw. The client does not show it in this form.

fields.name: json_output
fields.description: A value that the admin code set.

fields.name: output
fields.description: Text that the admin code set, or `"Exception: <error>"` when it threw. `""` when it set nothing.

fields.name: code
fields.description: The fixed code that shows `output` in a modal. `json_output` is `undefined` in this form, so JSON leaves it out.

senders.what: The admin `render` handler, after it runs `data.code` on the server with `eval`. It sends one of three forms: `window` set, `json_output` set, or neither.
